description: Screen a wallet address for on-chain risk. Returns a 0-100 risk score, risk level, verdict, and matched risk flags (honeypot / mintable / owner-not-renounced / blacklist, etc). Supports EVM (0x...) and TRON (T...) addresses. Use before receiving funds, interacting with a contract, or investing. 中文：筛查链上地址风险，返回 0-100 风险分、风险等级、判定结论与命中的风险标记（蜜罐/可增发/Owner未放弃/黑名单等）。支持 EVM(0x…) 与 TRON(T…) 地址。收款、交互、投资前使用。

chain.description: Chain. Defaults to auto-detect. Options: bsc / ethereum / base / arbitrum / tron. 中文：链，默认 auto 自动识别，可选 bsc / ethereum / base / arbitrum / tron

name: screen_address
